note: Synthetic single-review connectivity check; not part of the dataset run or the cost pilot.

criteria.cancellation: Explicitly leaving, uninstalling, cancelling, or threatening to
criteria.complaint: Reports a negative experience, including mixed praise and criticism
criteria.request: Asks for a change without reporting a failure
criteria.unclear: Unrelated, meaningless, or a bare slogan

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of the review?

criteria.1: No reported problem: praise, unclear content, or a pure feature request
criteria.2: Dislike, generic criticism, or minor annoyance; no functional loss
criteria.3: A degraded or restricted function; some use remains
criteria.4: A core task is clearly blocked, such as logging in or playing music
criteria.5: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm

severity.instructions: How severe is the reported impact?

criteria.access: Login, signup, password or account access
criteria.billing: Price, charges, subscriptions, paywalls, premium entitlement
criteria.catalog: Missing songs/artists, search/discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability
criteria.downloads: Downloading, saved music, offline listening, disappearing downloads
criteria.other: General praise/criticism, unrelated content, or no specific topic
criteria.playback: Playback failure, crashes, lag, connection failures, audio quality, resource use
criteria.support: Contacting support and the support response
criteria.usability: Navigation, controls, layout, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions

topic.instructions: Which product area is the main problem or praised feature in this app review?
